name: Custodian (Kraken)
summary: Hosted custodian with mandatory 2FA (authenticator). Account claim only — no private key. Counterparty and auth risks remain on the path.

name: Custodian (Wallet of Satoshi)
summary: Custodial Lightning with email-style login and no KYC (typical). Completes without a 2FA chooser.

name: Federated custody (stub)
summary: Placeholder — federated user story not rebuilt yet. Opens the stub, then legacy Fedi flow if you continue.

name: Single-key hot (BlueWallet)
summary: Self-custody on a phone app: convenient spending; malware and seed handling dominate risk.

name: Single-key cold (Ledger)
summary: Hardware single signature: stronger malware resistance when used correctly; supply-chain, entropy, and backups matter.

name: Air-gapped Seedsigner
summary: Stateless air-gapped signer with dice entropy; metal backup is the wallet.

name: Multisig (distributed)
summary: m-of-n with geographic/party distribution: removes single points of failure; watch same-vendor and same-country correlation.
